📖 How to use

  1. Enter your page title, description and image URL.
  2. See the link card rendered as Facebook, X and LinkedIn would show it.
  3. Copy the generated og: and twitter: meta tags into your page head.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What are Open Graph tags?

Meta tags (og:title, og:description, og:image…) that tell social platforms what title, description and image to show when your link is shared.

Why is my image not showing in the preview?

The image URL must be absolute (https://…) and publicly reachable. Hotlink-protected or relative URLs will not render here or on real platforms.

How big should the og:image be?

1200 × 630 px (1.91:1) is the safe standard — it fills Facebook and LinkedIn cards without cropping.
